title: Eliminate a choice
text: A counterexample shows the statement that $$a^c+b^c$$ can always be rewritten as $$\left(a+b\right)^c$$ to be false: $$2^2+1^2=5$$ but $$\left(2+1\right)^2=9$$.

title: True for a special case
text: It is true that $$a^1$$ $$\cdot$$ $$b^1=$$ $${ab}^1$$ $$=ab$$. But is that really the only time this holds? How can you be sure?

title: Try a test case
text: Try writing it out for a test case when $$c=2$$.
